title: byttneria biloba var. bauhinioides
intro: Byttneria biloba var. bauhinioides, commonly known as Bauhinia biloba, is a plant species in the Malvaceae family, native to tropical regions of Asia and the Pacific. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include wound healing, reducing fever, and treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Bauhinia biloba include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
